_about: Parts a scheduled-maintenance line needs, by the schedule's PreferredTerm, for the operations listed in operations (inspections and rotations need none). Part names follow the labor guide's convention: '(n)' is the quantity, and the NAPA lookup ignores the parentheses. Spark plugs are one per cylinder (engine_cylinders.json). confirm is what the advisor still checks before the final estimate. price: false means the catalog has no sensible unit to price (bulk fluids), so the part is listed to add by hand instead of priced.
